repos_data.description: Persistent memory for AI coding agents
A Claude Code plugin that gives Claude persistent memory across sessions — stores lessons and decisions as markdown in your Obsidian vault,...

repo_meta_data.description: The flight recorder for Claude Code. Persistent memory across sessions, hook-level capture of every edit, error and decision, and a bracket around /goal so an unattended run cannot poll all night, lose its record, or die silently. Nothing self-reported: the run report is what the hooks saw.
